title: i3ET Calculator: Light Vehicle Cradle-to-Gate Carbon Footprint
description:
A calculator for the mass and the cradle-to-gate greenhouse gas emissions of light passenger vehicles. It reimplements modules M1 (mass) and M2 (manufacturing GHG) of the i3ET model (Integrated Economic, Energy and Environment Transport Model) as an auditable, testable program with a web interface.

Results are in kg CO2e, GWP-100, IPCC AR6. The calculation reproduces the i3ET spreadsheet: vehicle mass on all 72 configurations (39 exact, 33 explained by modules out of scope) and cradle-to-gate emissions on the twelve reference vehicles of the Projeto do Berço ao Portão. Every missing emission factor is reported as absence of data, never as zero emissions.

Licensing is in three layers. Code: MIT. Documentation (docs/): CC BY 4.0. Data (data/): emission factors derived from GREET (UChicago Argonne, LLC), redistributed for non-commercial use only, with input values modified (extracted and processed by the i3ET); see data/NOTICE.md.

Version 0.9.0 precedes 1.0.0 on purpose: the documentation-sufficiency test (rebuilding the program from docs/ alone) is the acceptance criterion of the project and is scheduled for after the application is complete.
